extension.description: Mire Sirens is a community-maintained continuation of the Fen Light addon family. This add-on is intended for advanced Kodi users only. You must own the content of any media you play through this addon. This is an English language only add-on.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any of the content which is found and has no affiliation with any of the content providers.
extension.news: v1.0.23 - Fixed a NameError crash in the addon icon self-check service that masked the real underlying error (an HTTP 404 fetching the addon icon image, now also fixed on the repo side). v1.0.22 - Fixed MDBList-backed caches (Watchlist, Collection, watched history, playback bookmarks, dropped/hidden items, My Lists, curated lists) never expiring on their own - changes made outside this addon (mdblist.com directly, another device) could go unreflected indefinitely. Added a real 1-hour default expiry; explicit in-addon actions still invalidate instantly as before. Existing cache entries self-upgrade automatically, no manual clear needed. "Show Last MDBList Error" is exempted and persists as a log. v1.0.21 - Added retry-with-backoff for MDBList's own API rate limiting (HTTP 429), matching the fix already applied to TMDB calls in 1.0.17. Hardened "dropped shows" parsing (used by Remove from Collection's In Progress cascade) to tolerate MDBList's BETA endpoint response shape. v1.0.20 - "Remove from Collection" now cascades: also drops the show from In Progress and immediately invalidates Calendar's cache, instead of waiting for those to expire naturally. v1.0.19 - Audited every "Clear Cache" option; fixed 8 more that always reported Success regardless of whether the delete actually worked. All now verify emptiness before reporting success. v1.0.18 - "Clear Meta Cache" now verifies its tables are actually empty before reporting success, instead of always reporting Success. v1.0.17 - Fixed the real cause of widespread Calendar "0 episodes" results: TMDB rate-limiting the addon's default 60-concurrent-request burst, not a per-show bug. Added retry-with-backoff on TMDB 429s and capped Calendar concurrency to 15. v1.0.16 - Fixed season episode data being cached even when empty due to a failed/rate-limited TMDB call, freezing shows blank for days. Only real, non-empty results are cached now. Calendar Diagnostics can now export its report to a text file. v1.0.15 - Calendar Diagnostics now also shows the raw Watchlist/Collection ids and the resolved TMDB id per show, to catch cases like TMDB having multiple same-named shows. v1.0.14 - Added "Show Calendar Diagnostics" (Tools > Database & Cache Maintenance) to show exactly why a show does or doesn't appear in Calendar. v1.0.12 - Fixed Top 10 Box Office resolving to a stale, barely-populated list after its source was renamed. Added "Show Curated List Diagnostics". v1.0.11 - Diagnostic screens now use a scrollable text viewer instead of a popup that couldn't scroll or be copied. v1.0.10 - Added "Show Curated List Diagnostics" for troubleshooting Trending/Most Watched/Box Office resolution. v1.0.9 - Clear MDBList Cache now reports the exact number of entries removed instead of a generic "Success". v1.0.8 - Fixed "Because You Watched" (TV) and 3 related spots still reading from a dead local cache after the In Progress fix. v1.0.7 - Rebuilt movie/episode resume position ("Continue Watching") against MDBList's real playback-progress data. v1.0.6 - Fixed "In Progress"/"Watched" TV shows being empty by rebuilding against MDBList's actual watched history. v1.0.5 - Calendar now pulls from Collection as well as Watchlist. v1.0.4 - Fixed Top 10 Box Office being capped at one page of results. v1.0.3 - Fixed Calendar crashing on open, fixed a caching bug that could permanently freeze a blank result, first version bump so updates are visible in Kodi. v1.0.2 - Fixed Trakt sync pagination truncating watched history and in-progress items. v1.0.1 - Fixed Trending/Popular TV menus returning empty and Trakt Calendar erroring on null season/episode data. v1.0.0 - Initial release of Mire Sirens, a clean fork of Fen Light AM.
